title: Online Distributional Prediction via Latent Cluster Geometry Under Drift and Corruption
abstract: arXiv:2606.18778v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Online learning in non-stationary streams is often formulated as tracking a point estimate, although many applications require predicting the full data-generating distribution. We study online distributional prediction under drift and bounded causal adversarial corruption. Candidate laws are represented by variable-size latent cluster configurations that induce predictive distributions. A Gibbs quasi-posterior over configurations yields an online predictor by posterior averaging and can be sampled using reversible-jump MCMC. The method uses no stream likelihood but specifies a kernel-mixture predictive family. We evaluate cumulative Wasserstein-1 regret against the time-varying true law and study periodic restart, sliding-window, and exponential-discounting memory against full history. The bounds separate PAC-Bayesian complexity, corruption-sensitive posterior perturbation, and drift through $A_T^{\mathrm{OT}}=\sum_{t=2}^T W_2^

translated_title: 漂移与污染环境下基于潜在聚类几何的在线分布预测
translated_abstract: 非平稳数据流中的在线学习通常被表述为跟踪一个点估计，然而许多应用需要预测完整的数据生成分布。我们研究了在漂移和有界因果对抗污染下的在线分布预测问题。候选分布由可变大小的潜在聚类配置来表示，这些配置诱导出预测分布。通过在配置空间上构建Gibbs拟后验并进行后验平均，可以得到一个在线预测器，并可使用可逆跳转MCMC进行采样。该方法不依赖数据流的似然函数，而是指定了一个核混合预测族。我们针对时变的真实分布评估累积Wasserstein-1遗憾，并研究了周期性重启、滑动窗口和指数折扣记忆与全历史记忆的对比。所给出的界通过 $A_T^{\mathrm{OT}}=\sum_{t=2}^T W_2^...$ 将PAC-贝叶斯复杂度、污染敏感的后验扰动和漂移这三部分效应分离开来。
tldr: 该论文提出一种在漂移与对抗污染环境下基于潜在聚类几何配置的在线分布预测方法，利用Gibbs拟后验平均与可逆跳转MCMC进行预测，并给出了将PAC-贝叶斯复杂度、污染敏感后验扰动与漂移效应分离的累积Wasserstein-1遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online distributional prediction method based on latent cluster geometry under drift and bounded adversarial corruption, using Gibbs quasi-posterior averaging with reversible-jump MCMC sampling, and provides cumulative Wasserstein-1 regret bounds that disentangle PAC-Bayesian complexity, corruption-sensitive posterior perturbation, and drift effects.
